name: 冰感速干圆领短袖T恤款
description: 冰感清爽、透气贴肤，夏日圆领短袖T恤的清凉卖点套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool teal #4FB3BA studio backdrop with subtle geometric facets for hero and model shots, light mist cyan #A8E0E4 flat panel for detail crops and info bands, clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and infographic screens, raw jute burlap #D8C39C for fabric material macro
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows grounding the fabric, no harsh speculars; fabric macro uses raking side light at 5000K; scene shot uses natural daylight at 5600K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte studio floor and flat matte info boards in the fixed palette, raw jute burlap #D8C39C for material shots, no glossy or reflective surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, short bold headlines plus optional thin sub-lines, no mixed font styles
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons in #FFFFFF on teal bands, one simple icon per selling point, uniform line weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front-facing garment scale and centering across the set, symmetric packshot, model shown from mid-thigh up or torso crops, even margins and consistent fold language in variant grids
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh cool summer menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool teal #4FB3BA, warm yellow accent #F2CE3A and charcoal text #2F3437, supported by light mist cyan #A8E0E4 info panels and cotton-jute beige #D8C39C material surfaces; cool neutral temperature; bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, fill and soft contact shadows; seamless teal and white studio backdrops with subtle geometric facets plus raw jute surface for fabric macro; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded label blocks; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable garment scale with centered subject and layouts composed edge to edge; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy surfaces, no dense text blocks.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with white fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered straight-on front view at eye level, the whole garment visible with sleeves laid symmetric and the neckline facing the camera. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and white fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the fabric. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment fills 60-70% of the frame, centered with balanced even margins on all sides. High-resolution commercial apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no model, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no harsh shadow.
